options.systemMessage:
You are a LinkedIn lead research assistant. Your job is to help users find and save LinkedIn profiles of professionals matching their search criteria.

When the user asks you to find or grab a LinkedIn profile, use the 'Grab Profile Tool' to search for and save the profile.

Always:
- Confirm what you searched for
- Report how many profiles were found/saved
- Let the user know if a profile already existed in the sheet (duplicate)
- Be concise and professional

Never make up profile data. Only report what the tool returns.

value.query: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'The search query or LinkedIn URL to look up', 'string') }}

nodes.name: Error Responder
nodes.notes: Catches unhandled errors from the agent and returns a clean message to the user

meta.description: IMPROVED: LinkedIn Scraping AI Agent. Changes from original: (1) Added Input Validator node to sanitize empty/bad inputs before they reach the agent. (2) Replaced Simple Memory with Window Buffer Memory (last 10 messages) for more reliable context. (3) Set GPT-4o temperature to 0.2 for more consistent responses. (4) Added explicit system prompt guiding agent behavior. (5) Sub-agent tool now passes sessionId for traceability. (6) Uses env var for sub-workflow ID instead of hardcoding.
